question: Does a new Nebius Token Factory account still receive USD 1 of trial credit valid for 30 days? The Wayback Machine copy of docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/other-capabilities/billing-new dated 2026-09-16 10:24:40 UTC reads 'Upon first sign-up, you receive $1 in trial credit, valid for 30 days.' (web.archive.org/web/20260916102440id_/https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/other-capabilities/billing-new, sha256:5bfef4f85051c079d298f9042fcc86b8581eca7a6a20d4429f28ea91fc9648d7). The live page read on 2026-10-31 has no trial-credit sentence (sha256:efdc0dc2c9fe02d1cd408f9389217723b6e0c789ba95676457ce7b62c7744666), and its HTML carries '"dateModified":"2026-10-30T12:45:30.202Z"' (sha256:8ec02afb2780440124a857cb8998a8cd2d2d3b028b034875a971a7bbac369cfc); the older path /other-capabilities/billing answers 'Page Not Found' (sha256:f6880c5ae5b2d4b0c8603b5fa2cf611242a97bdadee2cccdbd8c02d9c697fdc5). The sentence left the page between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31; the exact date, and whether the credit is still granted, are unverified: behind a sign-up that requires a bank card.
why: the trial credit is the only signup credit reported for the offer, and third-party listings still repeat it; without it the offer is paid-only behind a card, with it trial-only behind a card
